cluster_unit: task (G = 24); seeds and offsets are paired repetitions within a task
pairing: Same task, seed and offset across every arm; arm order randomized within each task-seed block with Random(1000*task+seed)
tasks: task_geometry.ardy_offset_tasks(): 8 body headings x 3 text schedules; relative_offset target per window (same-noise unconstrained reference end + delta along body right), as M0c

accuracy.metric: end waypoint error: distance between the final root and the window target at the end-of-window frame, mean over the 50 windows of a run
accuracy.knob: MotionCorrection root_margin_m = epsilon - 0.01 m; epsilon 0.05 m is the native margin 0.04 m
accuracy.accurate_arm: cell mean (24 tasks x 3 seeds) of the end waypoint error <= epsilon at that offset

C2.role: C1 + PRIMAL inertialization (omega = 10 /s, zero offset velocity) at the window boundary, written back to history

C5a.role: C1, corrected window renoised to 20% of the denoising chain and denoised again with the same conditioning, written back

XFh.role: C1 + linear crossfade of the boundary offset (same half-decay time as C2, zero by 0.336 s), written back to history

development_smoke.data: offset task 10, seed 20, offset 1.0 m, one run per arm (develop_logs/test_runs/20261031_m1/smoke_a..c); not analyzed
observed: C0 and C1 bit-identical to the 20261030 M0c runs
inertialization leaves 13.6% of the boundary offset at the window end ((1 + 3.5) exp(-3.5)), end waypoint error 0.165 m at offset 1.0 m; crossfade reaches zero within the window and keeps 0.040 m
renoising: start replaced once per window, token round trip 2e-7 m, yet one denoising step from signal scale 0.986 returns the end error to 0.99 m
development_smoke.change: XFh (crossfade + history) moved from V3 into the M1 and Pareto arm sets before the pilot, so the equal-accuracy comparison contains a boundary smoother that can meet the accuracy criterion

M1.question: G1: at equal accuracy, does any existing arm remove the correction cost, or is there a Pareto gap a cost-aware correction can close
M1.grid: C0, C1, C2, C3a, C3b, C5a, C5b, XFh x 6 offsets x 24 tasks x 3 seeds at epsilon 0.05 m
M1.primary_endpoint: Per task, mean over seeds and offsets {0.1, 0.25, 0.5} of (boundary jerk at the 0.1 s step of the best accurate arm - C0). Best accurate arm at each offset: lowest cell-mean boundary jerk among arms with cell-mean end waypoint error <= 0.05 m
M1.gate: G1 passes when (a) the best accurate arm still raises boundary jerk by >= 20% over C0 with the cluster t interval excluding 0, or (b) no arm is accurate at some offset <= 0.5 m. Also reported: whether one arm is best at every offset (the 20261029 wording of G1)
M1.selection_note: The best arm is chosen from the same data; the per-offset choice is reported with its runner-up and their paired difference
secondary: cost-accuracy points per arm and offset
boundary jerk, 0.1 s jerk, trunk inclination, right upper-arm elevation, foot sliding, history consistency at 32 frames
denoiser calls and wall time per arm

M1-Pareto.grid: C1, C2, C5a, XFh x epsilon {0.02, 0.1} m x offsets {0.1, 0.5, 1.0} x 24 tasks x 3 seeds
M1-Pareto.use: cost-accuracy curves at three epsilon levels together with the epsilon 0.05 m grid; descriptive

V3-ARDY.question: Is inertialization a generic boundary smoother or tuned to PRIMAL: compare it with generic smoothing at the same time scale on corrected ARDY windows
V3-ARDY.grid: boundary {inertialization, crossfade, lowpass} x writeback {history, output only} at epsilon 0.05 m, offsets {0.25, 1.0}, 24 tasks x 3 seeds; inertialization + history is C2, crossfade + history is XFh and none is C1 (shared M1 runs); new arms C2o, XFo, LPh, LPo

treatments.inertialization: offset to the one-frame linear extrapolation of the last two committed output frames removed with (1 + omega t) exp(-omega t), omega = 10 /s
treatments.crossfade: same offset removed with a linear ramp of the same half-decay time (0.168 s; ramp length 0.336 s)
treatments.lowpass: Gaussian filter, sigma = 1/omega = 0.1 s, over the last 4 committed frames and the new window; only new-window frames replaced; rotations by projected weighted mean

V3-ARDY.stop_rule: Generic: boundary jerk reduction relative to C1 of crossfade or lowpass within +-10% of the inertialization reduction and end waypoint error regression within +-10% of it; otherwise tuned, and inertialization stays an M2 control arm
V3-ARDY.primal_part: omega sweep on PRIMAL registered separately after M1 (PRIMAL runs about 4 times longer)

inference.primary: Equal-weight task means of paired differences; cluster t interval with G-1 degrees of freedom and exact sign-flip p
inference.supplementary: Cluster bootstrap alongside, never as the decision interval
inference.multiplicity: One primary endpoint (G1) in this round

pilot.jobs: Offset task 10, seed 20, every arm, offset and epsilon of all three blocks
pilot.admission: Finite complete outputs; time within 3x estimate; frame-0 heading within 20 degrees of body forward; C0 and C1 at epsilon 0.05 m and offsets 0.1/0.25/0.5/1.0 bit-identical to the 20261030 M0c runs of the same task and seed; boundary treatment applied on every window after the first; renoise pass on every window with token round trip <= 1e-4 m; constraint guidance weight observed as registered; C1 and XFh end waypoint error <= epsilon + 0.005 m

conventions_not_derived.epsilon_m: 0.02 / 0.05 / 0.10 from the 20261029 plan; margin = epsilon - 0.01 m so the primary epsilon reproduces the native margin
conventions_not_derived.offsets_m: 0.05-1.0 m, six levels from the 20261029 plan
conventions_not_derived.omega: 10 /s as in PRIMAL; crossfade and lowpass time scales matched to it
conventions_not_derived.gate_threshold: 20% relative boundary-jerk increase, same convention as G0
conventions_not_derived.seeds: 3 seeds per task (5 in M0) to fit M1 + V3 in about one day on two GPUs
